title: Optimized scaled moment identity
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, and let $\lambda,t\in\mathbb R$ be positive. Set $q=\lambda t^{2/k}/e$. Then $\left(\frac{(\sqrt q\,\lambda^{1/q-1/2})^k}{t}\right)^q=\lambda^k\exp\!\left(-\frac{k\lambda t^{2/k}}{2e}\right)$.
replaced: Let $k>0$ be an integer and $\lambda,t>0$, and put $q=\lambda t^{2/k}/e$. Then $((\sqrt q\lambda^{1/q-1/2})^k/t)^q=\lambda^k\exp(-k\lambda t^{2/k}/(2e))$.
